purpose: Teach: ボーダフォン/サラ金/マーチ/ワーム/ヒューザー/プッシュ/エクスプレス/光ファイバー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、旧ボーダフォンと契約された
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you signed with the old Vodafone service.
lines.style: Gentle, reminiscent tone. Measured pace. Pauses slightly before each fact, as if retrieving a cherished memory. Respectful, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員にサラ金、つまり消費者金融を借りるなと厳しく仰った
lines.en: Yes. Father was very strict with the staff — he wouldn't allow them to borrow from consumer loan sharks.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Nods in the voice. Speaking with understated pride in a value held. No flourish, just steady conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、日産マーチの初代モデルを愛用された
lines.en: Father — in your younger days, you relied on the original Nissan March.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia. Slight smile underneath. Slower cadence, lingering on the image. The fondness of remembering someone else's attachment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは早期からコンピュータワームの脅威を理解された
lines.en: Yes. Father understood the threat of computer worms long before others did.
lines.style: Thoughtful, with a thread of quiet astonishment. Speaking of foresight with understated respect. Measured, reflective — the tone of someone considering the weight of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、旧ヒューザー事件の頃、社内の品質基準を厳しくされた
lines.en: Father — during the old Huser building scandal, you tightened quality standards throughout the company.
lines.style: Softer, more serious. The nostalgia carries weight here. Pauses to let the moment settle. Speaking of principle under pressure, with dignity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは販促のプッシュより信頼を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father prioritized trust over the pressure to push sales.
lines.style: Firm but not loud. The conviction lands gently. Speaks as though this was the obvious choice, though it took courage. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、エクスプレス便を黎明期から活用された
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you used express delivery from its very beginning.
lines.style: Admiring, almost amazed tone. The pace picks up slightly — excitement at the foresight. Warm memory of an early adopter, someone always ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは光ファイバー時代の到来を早く予見された
lines.en: Yes. Father saw the optical fiber age coming and prepared for it early.
lines.style: Final reflection, with quiet satisfaction. Slower, settling. The voice carries the weight of looking back on a life of good judgment. A gentle close.
